title: Mobility Equipment Rate Card — Daily Rate of the Day Credit on a Kept Cash-Sale Chair
content:
# Daily Rate of the Day Credit — Kept Cash-Sale Mobility Equipment Chairs

**Rate card.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash that the patient keeps, the daily rate of the day credit is set by the chair's class and by how its own delivery (its purchase or initial rental delivery, not a loaner delivery) was made: 13.42 for a power chair, 2.05 for a manual chair whose own delivery was into the home with training, 1.53 for a manual chair whose own delivery was by courier, and the standard daily rate for a manual chair whose own delivery was made any other way.

## Rates (USD per day counted)

| Class type | Own delivery | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| power | any | 13.42 |
| manual | in-home delivery with training | 2.05 |
| manual | courier | 1.53 |
| manual | any other (for example branch pickup) | the standard daily rate, unchanged |

The chair's own delivery is its purchase delivery or initial rental delivery in its service history; a loaner delivery never sets the rate.

## Hypothetical cases

- Power chair: 13.42 a day, however it was delivered.
- Manual chair whose purchase delivery was by courier: 1.53 a day, even if a loaner was later brought into the home.
- Manual chair collected at a branch: the standard daily rate.
